title: Strict RFC 4180 record parser
skill: Writing a correct state machine from a precise grammar
traps: a trailing line break does not create an extra record, but a blank line in the middle (or a second trailing break) does
quoted fields keep embedded CR/LF verbatim
a quote inside an unquoted field is a literal character
text after a closing quote is an error, not concatenation
"" alone is one empty field; a trailing comma adds an empty field
